protocol_measures.requirement: Collateral must be explicitly allowlisted before deposits are accepted.
Token transfers must use SafeERC20-style wrappers so no-return and false-return tokens are handled safely.
Inbound token handling must compare balance before and after transfer to detect received amount deltas.
Collateral amounts with non-18 decimals must be normalized before share accounting.
Adapters must support zero-reset approval flows for legacy allowance behaviors.
Token callbacks and hook-based transfers must be fenced by reentrancy protection.
Upgradeable collateral must be monitored for implementation changes before continuing deposits.
The protocol must have an explicit blocklist and pause handling path for centrally controlled collateral.
Collateral whose balances can change outside transfers must trigger explicit external-balance resynchronization before share math.

policy_notes: Use the staged reference notes and token behavior profiles to decide which measures each token needs.
